dct_description_sm: Bahrain administrative level 0 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset. The date that these administrative boundaries were established is unknown. This COD-AB was most recently reviewed for accuracy and necessary changes in December 2024. Sourced from FAO GUAL DATA 2008_WFP Vetting by Information Technology Outreach Services (ITOS) with funding from USAID. There is no suitable population statistics dataset (COD-PS) for linkage to this COD-AB.. As this is an island country, no edge-matched (COD-EM) version of this COD-AB is required. Please see the [COD Portal](https://cod.unocha.org/). Recommended cartographic projection: Asia South Albers Equal Area Conic This metadata was last updated on January 17, 2025.
